# Nick Havryliak

Repeat founder, investor, father and explorer. Based in San Francisco.
Building financial infrastructure for the agent economy (in stealth).

Previously founded Assisterr (2023-2026): $2.8M raised, 5M+ users, 42k AI agents
deployed, 200+ B2B integrations. Backed by Google for Startups, Outlier Ventures,
Echo.xyz and Taisu Ventures. Closed in Q3 2026.

Alum of Cambridge Judge Business School, Entrepreneur First, Outlier Ventures and
Google for Startups. LP in Dnipro VC and Contango VC; angel in 100+ YC-backed teams.
